Are you ready to kickstart your career in Insurance and Broking in a global organization and join a dynamic, international team? Marsh Denmark is seeking a Student Assistant for our Risk Management (RM) Placement team in Copenhagen.

**About The Team

**Our Copenhagen team is part of Marsh’s global network, collaborating with colleagues across the Nordics and Europe to deliver market-leading solutions in Property, Construction and Liability insurance. We work with a variety of clients, from mid-size to large multinationals, providing innovative support tailored to each client’s unique challenges.

You will be part of a team where you have the opportunity to work together with highly skilled brokers on daily tasks, client presentations, data preparation towards insurance tenders etc., while you learn about the role as a specialized broker. Join a passionate team that understands the importance of delivering fast and efficient quality service to our clients.

We place great emphasis on a flat organizational structure and an informal work environment that prioritizes open and efficient communication.

The position requires approximately 15 hours of work per week at our office for a minimum of two years.

**What You Will Do

**

• Supporting brokers with daily tasks

• Analyze and assess complex property and business interruption risks

• Data collection from clients and insurers

• Create presentations in collaboration with brokers

• Support with overviews of quotations from insurance markets

• Support standards, templates, and best practices for the team

**Your profile

**We are looking for a colleague currently pursuing a higher education degree. In addition, you should:

• Have an aptitude for IT and AI systems

• Take pride in delivering high-quality work

• Have strong written and verbal communication skills in both Danish and English

• Enjoy learning new things and be able to handle tasks independently to ensure brokers and clients receive excellent service.

**What Makes You Stand Out

**

• Strong analytical skills and ability to transform data into actionable recommendations

• Effective, positive, and solution-oriented communicator

• You are curious and enjoy learning new things

• You thrive on varied tasks and not always knowing what tasks await you when you arrive at work

You can read more about Marsh Denmark here: www.marsh.com

Please submit your CV in English.

**Why join our team:

**

• We help you perform at your best through opportunities for professional development, exciting work, and supportive leadership.

• We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and make a positive difference for colleagues, clients, and society.

• A challenging role in a dynamic, fast-evolving organization, offering excellent opportunities for personal and professional growth. You will be part of a professional team that prioritizes well-being, expertise, and skills development within a diverse work environment that you can help shape.

**Contact

**If you have any questions to the role or about Marsh, then please reach to to hiring manager, Mads Vendelbo Nielsen, mads.nielsen@marsh.com.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

**Be a part of our Group Stakeholder Relations team – an important contributor in our NKT’s growth journey

**To meet the growth of NKT we are now expanding our Group Function responsible for Stakeholder Relations with a new role as "Stakeholder Relations Coordinator".

This new role will be responsible for initiating and driving public stakeholder engagements in especially Denmark, Sweden, Germany and at international events such as Folkemødet, Almedalen, New York High Level Week, UN COP’s, Wind Europe, Munich Security Conference, North Sea Cooperation etc.

NKT is a world leading innovator, manufacturer, installer and repairer of power cable systems. NKT is 135 years old company which experiences a period of historic growth as a key partner in reliable electrification of our homes, cities and societies. With this growth also comes an increasing number of requests and opportunity to engage with our key external stakeholders.

In the role of Group Stakeholder Relations Coordinator, you will support and coordinate our activities in larger selected public and political events in key markets and institutions addressing our key stakeholders. In doing so, you will work closely with other members of our team as well as other Group functions and Business Lines and coordinate with the EA’s for our C-level. With this new role NKT set out to play an even more visible and important role in shaping the public agenda, nationally and internationally.

You will be reporting directly to our Head of Group Stakeholder Relations, Michael Suhr. The department reports to the Chief Commercial Officer, who is member of NKT’s Corporate Leadership Team which also includes our CEO, CFO and COO. You will therefore be an important part of securing the right externa platforms and providing important input for the branding of NKT at these events.

**As Group Stakeholder Relations Coordinator, You Will

**

• Oversee the day-to-day responsibilities of planning, coordinating and conducting our engagement in larger public events to help NKT in close collaboration with NKT’s other Group functions, C-level EA’s and our business lines;

• Assess gaps and opportunities for the involvement of NKT in larger public events;

• Develop and implement a public engagement and messaging strategy;

• Continuously update stakeholder engagement strategies and identify crucial global public events, where NKT can promote and guide the shift toward a more electrified society;

• Establish credible relationships with key public stakeholders and interest organizations;

• Develop and implement joint advocacy initiatives with other external stakeholders.

**Knowledge about public stakeholder engagement in a new geopolitical and geoeconomic world order

**To work well with this role, you

• like to take initiative and collaborate with ease with a broad variety of internal and external stakeholders,

• are concrete, factual and meticulously following through.

• have good communication skills both in writing and orally.

Additionally, you have had some of the following experiences in the past:

• Working with larger public events and coordinating them;

• Significant knowledge of European and global political events. Knowledge of energy policy is an advantage;

• Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with external stakeholders such as interest organizations, NGOs and political parties;

• Strong interpersonal skills and ability to enable effective relationships locally, across a global organization; and with external agencies and partners;

• Political flair and business insight;

• Ability to work collaboratively on projects in a complex environment with a variety of internal and external stakeholders;

• Positive skills in co-ordination and organization. Fluent in English and knowledge of Danish and German an advance.

The position is located at our headquarter in Nordhavn, Denmark, along with your manager and our C-level.

You may expect to travel for up to 50 days in connection with the events and activities planned but likely to be much less depending on profile and wishes.

**Contact and application

**Apply with your CV and cover letter via the link below as soon as possible, but no later than 29th of November 2026.

If you have any questions regarding the position or inquiries about the position, please reach out to VP, Stakeholder Relations, Michael Suhr, Michael.suhr@nkt.com. If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please reach out to Global HR Business Partner Morten Skårup Sponholtz, morten.sponholtz@nkt.com.

Kindly note that due to GDPR regulations, we cannot accept any applications via e-mail.

NKT is committed to fostering a diverse organization and a culture where people from different backgrounds can thrive and are inspired to perform at their best. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work.

Welcome with your application!

**About NKT

**_NKT connects a greener world with high-quality power cable technology and takes centre stage as the world moves towards green energy. NKT designs, manufactures and installs low-, medium- and high-voltage power cable solutions enabling sustainable energy transmission. Since 1891, NKT has innovated the power cable technology building the infrastructure for the first light bulbs to the megawatts created by renewable energy today. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and employs 6,500 people. NKT is listed on Nasdaq Copenhagen and realised a revenue of EUR 3.6 billion in 2025. We connect a greener world. www.nkt.com

**Your impact begins here

**As Consumer Analytics & Reporting Manager, you will turn large, complex consumer data into dashboards, reports and analysis that Consumer Care and regional teams can trust and act on. You will build the reporting engine behind consumer campaigns across digital media, NovoCare, WegovyCare and other DtP channels, with consistent KPIs and validated data. Your work helps teams see what drives results, optimise faster and engage people living with serious chronic diseases in more relevant ways.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• A Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, marketing, business or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

• Relevant experience in consumer or marketing analytics.

• Experience delivering technical projects, including estimating development, managing dependencies, reviewing deliverables, and driving rollout and adoption.

• Experience with recurring performance reporting across diverse data sources.

• The ability to assess data quality and measurement limitations, distinguish correlation from causation and turn findings into testable recommendations.

• Good change management skills, including driving adoption of new tools, workflows and capabilities across diverse teams.

• An understanding of privacy, consent and promotional review considerations when using consumer engagement data.

• A structured, curious and commercially minded approach, with the ability to explain evidence, uncertainty and actions in plain language.

• A collaborative, influential and organised way of working, balancing recurring reporting with deeper analysis and following through on agreed actions.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Intermediate Power BI development experience, including basic DAX, Power Query, SQL and data modelling.

• Experience in FMCG.

• Experience with brand tracking and social listening.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be the hands-on link between consumer strategy and the data that shows whether it is working. For some projects you will build and model the data yourself; for others you will lead the collaboration with platform teams to get the right data in place.

• Partner with Consumer Care and regional teams to understand what success looks like for consumer engagement, and turn it into practical analytics and reporting.

• Build, maintain and improve consumer analytics solutions, such as dashboards or agents, and act as the Consumer Care super user.

• Establish a reliable reporting engine with unified KPI and metric definitions, clean and documented data, and recurring business reports covering journeys and campaigns across digital media, NovoCare, WegovyCare, partner sites and other DtP channels.

• Agree campaign objectives, KPIs, benchmarks and reporting cadence with campaign owners at activation, and specify data, tagging and tracking requirements with platform and data owners.

• Validate results, investigate discrepancies, troubleshoot issues and manage access, so reports truthfully display results.

• Track brand health and social conversation, assess what drives results across audiences, messages and touchpoints, and lead insight review sessions that turn findings into campaign optimisation and prioritised actions.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Consumer Care, Content & Media in International Operations, reporting to Alejandra Betancourt, Content Associate Vice President. In International Operations, colleagues work across markets to serve people around the world and help improve health at scale.

Your closest partners will be the Consumer Care team and global and regional consumer teams, who you will help turn strategy into measurement plans and reporting. You will also work with Enterprise AI, platform and data owners, and the teams responsible for our CDP data foundation to enable data access, pipelines and tracking. Stakeholder feedback will help shape the priorities and roadmap of the Engagement Intelligence team.

Your scope is global, primarily excluding the US and China, with reporting and insight support for relevant regions and affiliates. You will adapt analyses to local channel availability, market context and applicable requirements, always in alignment with regional representatives.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will work in an international environment where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. You will be trusted to take ownership of the quality and reliability of consumer analytics, supported by colleagues across Consumer Care, regional teams, Enterprise AI and platform teams. Working across functions and markets gives you the opportunity to build new skills, broaden your perspective and see your work adopted by teams who rely on it.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 651,000.00 to 956,900.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy **here.****Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn consumer data into trusted insight and measurable progress, apply for the Consumer Analytics & Reporting Lead role by 18 November 2026.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**WHY SPEKTR

**At spektr, we are on a mission to automate the world’s most complex compliance workflows through AI. Founded by the team behind HelloFlow (acquired by Trulioo), spektr is building the infrastructure and AI agents to run compliance at scale.

_Compliance, built like product.

_Financial services has changed enormously. Much of the technology behind compliance hasn’t. Teams still spend hours on manual checks, disconnected systems slow down launches, and entering a new market can mean rebuilding the same processes all over again.

We’re changing that. spektr gives regulated businesses one platform for onboarding, monitoring and investigations, with configurable workflows and AI agents that do the legwork. Product, Operations and Compliance can move together, with the control they need to grow.

It’s a huge opportunity in an industry that has moved slowly for too long. We’ve built a product we’re proud to put in front of the most demanding customers. Now we’re looking for people who want to help get it into their hands.

• $26M raised, including a $20M Series A led by NEA, with backing from Northzone, Seedcamp and PreSeed Ventures.

• Customers worth getting excited about. We work with businesses including Pleo, Trustly, Nexi and Santander. These are large accounts with complex problems, ambitious teams and plenty of room for us to make a difference.

• Three offices: Copenhagen, London and Iași, with customers across more than 15 countries.

**THE OPPORTUNITY

**We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us build and scale high-quality, reliable products as we grow.

You’ll work closely with backend engineers, product managers, and customer-facing teams to build and maintain the automated testing that keeps our platform behaving exactly as intended, especially across complex, AI-driven, API-first systems. If you enjoy writing solid test code, finding the edge cases others miss, and helping teams ship with confidence, you’ll feel at home here.

**What You Will Be Doing

**

• Test Automation: Design, build and maintain scalable automated E2E test suites using Playwright, using LLMs to speed up test generation and maintenance.

• Agent Validation: Build and run test cases and evals that validate AI agent behaviour, so our autonomous compliance workflows are accurate, explainable and hallucination-free.

• API & Data Validation: Test RESTful APIs and validate complex data flows, checking data directly in the database so frontend, backend and AI systems stay fully aligned.

• CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so AI model updates and deployments don’t break existing logic.

• Production Issues: Investigate production issues, reproduce failures and turn them into automated regression tests.

• Quality Practices: Work with engineers and PMs early in development on testability and acceptance criteria, and contribute to our QA processes and standards.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• The Scale-up Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments and prefer building systems over following manuals.

• Automation Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks like Playwright.

• API & Database Skills: You’re comfortable navigating backend services, testing RESTful APIs and verifying data integrity with SQL.

• Maintainable Test Code: You don’t just write scripts. You write clean, reusable tests that the rest of the team can build on.

• Communication Skills: You can explain a bug or edge case clearly to both a PM and an engineer.

• Detail Obsession: You have a “sixth sense” for where a system might break and a genuine passion for delivering a polished user experience.

• Curiosity about AI testing: Exposure to testing LLM-based features or eval frameworks is a strong plus.

**OUR TECH INTERESTS

**

• Languages: JavaScript / TypeScript

• Testing: Playwright

• AI/ML: LLM Prompting, LangChain/AutoGPT concepts, Evals frameworks

• Infrastructure: API-driven architectures, SQL databases, CI/CD pipelines

**OUR PROCESS

**

• Intro call with our Talent team (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (30 minutes)

• Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**How To Apply

**We hire the smartest, kindest, and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work. You’ll be joining a team with a proven track record and the "Product-Market Fit" to change an entire industry.

spektr is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic, and we assess every candidate against the same role requirements.

**Build software at scale. Influence how we build it. Help shape the next generation of development at Dalux.

**Dalux is growing, and we are looking for experienced software developers who want significant technical ownership while continuing to build software hands-on.

You will work on products used by professionals around the world, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us improve how we develop software – including how we use agentic AI to make capable developers more effective.

**Your role

**As an Experienced Software Developer, you will take ownership of complex product and technical problems from idea to production.

You will work in a product team with other developers, a Product Manager, and a Product Designer. We expect experienced developers to contribute beyond their individual tasks by making good technical decisions, improving our architecture and development practices, and sharing knowledge with others.

Your work can include:

• Owning complex features and technical problems end-to-end

• Designing scalable, maintainable solutions and contributing to architectural decisions

• Improving our codebase, tooling, developer workflows, and technical quality

• Driving or contributing to initiatives around DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure, architecture, or developer tooling

• Sparring with and mentoring other developers

• Working closely with Product Management and Design to understand problems and find the right solutions

• Bringing new ideas and technologies into Dalux when they can improve our products or how we build them

We expect experienced developers to have opinions, challenge existing solutions, and be comfortable having their own ideas challenged in return.

**Developing software with agentic AI

**We are significantly increasing our use of agentic AI in software development.

We use and explore AI across the development lifecycle – from understanding problems and navigating codebases to implementation, testing, debugging, refactoring, and review.

We are looking for developers who already use agentic AI as part of their development workflow. The specific tools matter less than how you use them: providing the right context and direction, critically evaluating the output, and knowing when to intervene or take a different approach.

Strong engineering fundamentals remain essential. AI can increase what a capable developer can achieve, but you remain responsible for the architecture, correctness, maintainability, and quality of the software you build.

At Dalux, you will help us take these ways of working further by experimenting, sharing what works, and helping establish effective practices for agentic software development.

**Technologies we work with

**Our platform is built on a distributed cloud architecture using AWS. Our primary technologies include:

• C# / .NET

• Angular / TypeScript

• GitHub Copilot

• MSSQL

• Elasticsearch

• AWS

• Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You may also encounter parts of our C++ codebase.

Experience with our exact technology stack is useful, but strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to understand and improve complex systems matter more.

**Product development at Dalux

**Our developers do more than implement specifications.

Developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers work together to understand problems and find solutions that balance user value, usability, technical feasibility, business viability, and long-term technical health.

Our products are relied upon by professionals worldwide, making performance, stability, maintainability, and quality important parts of everyday engineering.

**Your background

**We expect that you:

• Have solid professional software development experience

• Have at least six months of practical experience using agentic AI as part of your software development workflow

• Hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related technical field

• Have strong software engineering fundamentals

• Are comfortable owning complex technical problems and decisions

• Can navigate and improve an established codebase and architecture

• Care about maintainability, reliability, performance, and quality

• Enjoy technical sparring and sharing knowledge with other developers

• Understand the trade-offs between short-term delivery and long-term technical quality

Experience with C#/.NET, Angular, or cloud development is useful, but we do not expect you to match every technology we use.

**What You Can Expect From Dalux

**Dalux is a software company at heart. As an experienced developer, you can expect:

• Significant ownership and real influence on technical solutions

• Skilled colleagues who enjoy technical discussion and constructive challenge

• Close collaboration between Engineering, Product Management, and Design

• Short paths from ideas to decisions and implementation

• Opportunities to improve engineering practices beyond your immediate product work

• An environment actively investing in agentic AI for software development

• High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems

All Dalux software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. Working together in person is an important part of how we collaborate, share knowledge, and make decisions quickly.

**About Dalux

**Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop software used in more than 140 countries worldwide.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house, giving our developers the opportunity to influence both the products and the technology behind them.

**Interested?

**If you want significant technical ownership while helping shape how modern software is developed at Dalux, we would like to hear from you.

**If agentic AI is already part of how you develop software, tell us how you use it – what you delegate, how you validate the result, and where you have found it genuinely useful.

**We recruit continuously and hire multiple experienced developers throughout the year as Dalux grows.

If you have questions about the position, contact IT Talent Acquisition Specialist Sara Nielsen on SNI@dalux.com

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Our operations team is looking for a Property Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will partner closely with our software engineers to shape the future of our platform. You’ll have the opportunity to span the entire process, from managing complex portfolios and advising landlords to deciding which manual tasks our engineers should automate next.

Do you spend your entire day in UNIK or EG Bolig on stuff and wonder if it could be automated and taken care of by robots? We want to change that. Right now is the best time to join because you’ll get the chance to shape your own role and help us enter new markets across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by 90s software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and legal notices to strip human error and bureaucracy out of the rental experience. By removing the friction, we allow landlords and tenants to actually communicate, putting the human connection back at the centre of the business.

Proper is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property operator. We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with software engineers and product designers to shape our product with your domain expertise.

• Own the portfolio: Manage the daily administration, including lease contracts, rent adjustments, compliance, and maintenance.

• Bridge the gap: Identify the friction points in your daily work and help the product team decide on what to build next.

• Be the expert: Act as the primary advisor for landlords on the complex side of property: legislation, strategy, and finance.

• Operate at scale: Pilot our automated systems to manage a portfolio size that would be impossible at a traditional firm.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have a minimum of 2 years experience in property management and actually enjoy solving the puzzles of the Danish Rental Act.

• Done with legacy tech: You’ve used the old systems and you know they suck. You probably already have ideas on how to fix them.

• A "product" thinker: You don’t just want to follow a checklist; you want to build a better system.

• Numbers don’t scare you: You’re comfortable with budgets, utility accounts, and tools like Visma e-conomic.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable assuming ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish for legal documents and English for our office culture.

**What You’ll Get

**Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

The team and the code. You’ll lead four engineers and keep building core features. You might coach a developer through a tricky problem in the morning and ship a feature yourself that afternoon. As the team grows, you’ll help hire the people you’ll work alongside.

How we build and ship. You’ll guide the platform’s architecture and how we test and release. Our goal is to ship several times a week while keeping the product reliable and secure. Success to decide which problems Tily should tackle next.

We talk a lot (in a good way). When a problem gets tricky, we pull up a chair and pair on it. We like having a laugh while we figure things out.

What you’ll bring?

You’ve led an engineering team at a startup or scale-up while the product, the team and the rules were still taking shape. You know when to open a pull request yourself, when to let another engineer make the call, and which shortcut will come back to bite you two releases from now.

You bring curiosity about our industry, our customers' problems, and the business acumen to understand how our product delivers business value, so that you can help facilitate features that drive outcomes and make our users' lives easier.

We’re AI-first (the name’s a bit of a giveaway). If you’ve built an agent or shipped an AI feature, we’d love to hear what happened after the demo. What did customers trust it to do, and where did they want the controls back? You’ll get to make those calls with Tily and figure out where AI helps our own engineers ship better software.

The core of what we consider for a candidate

• You’ve led an engineering team, coached developers, and hired people to join it.

• You’re keen to build AI agents that customers can put to work and to explore where AI makes your own team more effective.

• You still build full-stack features with React, TypeScript, and SQL. You can take a feature from technical design through thoughtful user experience to release, and measure what happens when customers get their hands on it.

• Fluent in English

Experience we’d love to hear about

• Shipping an AI agent or feature into production. We’re especially curious about what you changed after people started using it.

• How you’ve spoken with customers and industry experts to help ensure we’re on the forefront of solving the right problems in our platform

• Your perspective on the role of a CTO as a thought leader.

• Working with PostgreSQL or Next.js, or building products for real estate or proptech.

Where we work

We spend 4 days a week together in our office near Rådhuspladsen. You’ll need to be based in the Copenhagen area, as we can’t offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.

New to proptech? That’s fine. If you’ve led engineers and still enjoy being one, we’d love to hear from you.

Questions? Reach out to Casper høgh at Csh@ing.dk, who helps us land the right human for the job

Our hiring process

• Intro call with Casper Høgh – We’ll talk about your background, what you want from your next CTO role, and any questions you have about proprty.ai.

• In-person interview – Meet us at our Copenhagen office for a small demo and talk through the team, the decisions you’d own, and how you like to lead while staying hands-on.

• Case interview – Work through an engineering scenario with us. We want to understand what you’d prioritize, which trade-offs you see, and why.

• Board interview - Meet with one of our board members. Get their perspective on our journey and talk them through how you would help us in our next phase of growth.

• Offer – If we both see a fit, we’ll talk through the offer and next steps together.

Want to get in early with a great team? Love leading engineers and still writing code?

Apply now to lead our dev team and make building maintenance smarter and more sustainable with AI.

**Location: Måløv, Denmark

**Qualifications

You are proactive in identifying discrepancies and improving procedures, and you take pride in maintaining an organised warehouse where stock levels and the location of goods can be accounted for at all times.

You are comfortable working independently, prioritising tasks and coordinating with colleagues across different functions. You communicate effectively in Danish and English.

Relevant experience in logistics or project-driven warehouse operations, preferably involving the use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, will be considered an advantage.

Practical Information

The position is based at our warehouse facilities in Copenhagen.

Salary will reflect qualifications and experience.

Department: RevOps

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**Factbird is a manufacturing intelligence suite that turns real-time production data into actionable insights. Our plug-and-play hardware and AI-powered SaaS solution help manufacturers cut downtime, improve efficiency and reduce waste. We are around 100 people across Europe and the US, growing more than 50% year over year. We have just partnered with the private equity firm Verdane to strengthen our product roadmap and expand our reach even further.

We have built a solid Revenue Operations foundation, with HubSpot as our CRM, BigQuery as our data warehouse, and Power BI and Claude for reporting that the leadership team and the board rely on. Now we want to take the next step. We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager who doesn't just keep the engine running, but tells us where to steer it.

This is a role for someone who looks at our numbers and asks "so what?" Which segments should we double down on? Where is the funnel leaking? Which investments will pay back? What can we do even better? You will help answer those questions and make sure the answers lead to action.

**The role

**You will own Revenue Operations across the full customer journey, from the first marketing touch to sales, onboarding, renewal, and expansion. Your job is to unify the processes, technology, and data behind our revenue teams so that growth becomes more predictable, transparent, and scalable.

You will be based at our office at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, report to the CFO, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and the senior leadership team. You will lead our Business Intelligence Analyst, who owns the data warehouse, the data pipelines, and the Power BI dashboards.

You will thrive here if you combine a commercial mindset with analytical rigor, and you enjoy turning a messy question into a clear recommendation that a leadership team can act on.

**What You'll Do

**Planning and GTM

• Turn performance, customer, and market data into clear recommendations: where to invest, which segments and industries to prioritize, and what isn't working.

• Support commercial planning with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, including targets, quotas, and capacity planning.

• Support sales leadership on territory design, lead routing, and pipeline coverage.

Data and Intelligence

• Develop the commercial KPIs that matter across the funnel, such as pipeline, conversion, win rates, CAC, churn, and net revenue retention, and understand the data behind it.

• Own the monthly commercial performance reporting for the leadership team and present the story and learnings behind the numbers.

• Lead deep-dive analyses, such as ICP and industry performance, win/loss and churn drivers, and recommend corrective actions.

• Lead and develop our Business Intelligence Analyst: set priorities, goals, and development plans.

Best in Class Processes

• Map our processes from lead to renewal, find the bottlenecks, and fix them together with Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

• Design workflows and hand-offs that cut admin time and improve data quality for Marketing, Sales and Customer Success.

Technology and AI

• Foster the adoption of AI across Sales, Marketing and Customer Success: connect AI assistants to our CRM and data, and build AI-powered workflows for enrichment, lead scoring and reporting. AI-powered tools in our current stack include Gong, Amplemarket, Claude and Dreamdata.

• Measure the impact of AI and automation on productivity and pipeline.

Revenue Funnel Pursuit

• Give the revenue teams the insights, tools and cadences they need at every stage of the funnel, from demand generation to renewal and expansion.

• Support Marketing on attribution, intent data and campaign reporting.

• Support Customer Success with health, churn-risk and expansion insights.

Project Management

• Plan and deliver cross-functional revenue projects from scope to measurable impact.

• Lead the change management that comes with new processes and tools, so they stick.

**What We're Looking For

**We are looking for a commercially minded problem solver who uses data to drive decisions and create value. You understand what drives growth in a B2B business, you are comfortable in front of a leadership team, and you are hands-on enough to get into HubSpot yourself.

The ideal background

• 5 to 7 years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, commercial analytics, strategy or management consulting, or a similar role.

• Experience from a B2B SaaS or tech scale-up, where you have seen what drives growth up close.

• A proven track record of turning data into insights and recommendations that leaders acted on.

• Strong analytical skills: you may have been a Business Intelligence Analyst in the past. You are definitely at home with funnel metrics, unit economics and forecasting, and you can build a model in Excel or a BI tool.

• Solid HubSpot experience and you will need to be confident as its Super Admin.

• Curiosity about AI, and practical experience using it to automate work or get more out of data.

• Clear communication in English, written and spoken, at leadership and board level.

How you work

• You think like a business owner and always ask what a number means for growth.

• You work autonomously, take ownership, and see what could be better before anyone asks. You help the teams around you turn those ideas into real improvements.

• You build trust across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance, and you can challenge with facts.

• You enjoy coaching others and want to develop the analyst on your team.

• You like structure, but you are happy to build it where it doesn't exist yet.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams - and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide gatherings & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity

**The Clients & Industries (C&I) Revenue Planning Lead will have overall global oversight and leadership of the Global C&I Revenue Planning Team within the Enablement & Technology domain. The role will team closely with Global and Region Clients & Industries Leadership and domains on cross-functional initiatives and translate EY’s strategic priorities into the revenue planning business process.

The role will lead the continued evolution of global sales and revenue planning, strengthening the processes, governance and capabilities that connect account-level growth ambitions with regional and global business priorities. Working across markets, service lines and strategic growth areas, the role will help translate growth ambitions into actionable sales and revenue plans, focusing on topline growth, where and how the business will grow. It does not own P&L, financial forecasting, budgeting or expense planning, which remain Finance responsibilities.

Serve as the primary relationship lead to Global and Region leadership, connecting sales and revenue planning priorities with broader business objectives, enabling alignment, strengthening adoption, and accelerating decisions.

This includes active management of all sales and revenue planning business processes globally, aligned to and informed by evolving business needs. The role will collaborate with teams to identify and enable opportunities to use AI and advanced technologies to improve planning effectiveness, decision support, process efficiency and user adoption across the revenue planning lifecycle. The role will also have a hands-on delivery role across the range of sales and revenue planning activities.

The role will be responsible for performance management of the Revenue Planning Team, including LEAD counselor responsibilities and the integration of GDS resource capability.

As a key member of the Enablement & Technology domain, the role will collaborate on a broader set of Global Clients & Industries priorities and may act as sponsor for agreed strategic initiatives.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**Some or all the below will be applicable depending on the scope and team alignment of the role.

• 
Sales & Revenue Planning

• 
Continue to build, refine, and manage sales and revenue planning

• 
Implement and maintain consistency of sales and revenue planning governance globally

• 
Establish trusted, long-term relationships with senior leaders to understand their priorities and translate them into coordinated revenue planning actions

• 
Shape and sustain strategic stakeholder alignment across Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation, Industry, and Client Excellence, providing strategic leadership and influence to align cross-functional priorities to enable a consistent global revenue planning process

Participate in and contribute to efforts to ensure consistency of integrated planning processes and protocols across Clients & Industries, Finance, Regions, Services Lines, Growth & Innovation, and IT

Process improvement

Leverage AI and advanced technologies to streamline revenue planning processes, improve data quality and insight generation, and increase efficiency, accuracy and decision support

Effective teaming

Leverage and elevate GDS resource capability across the Clients & Industries revenue planning landscape

Manage Clients & Industries and other EY stakeholder relationships - Clients & Industries pillar leaders, Finance, Regions, Service Lines, Growth & Innovation - and identify opportunities for effective collaboration

Possess a high level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability

Convert planning data or abstract concepts into sharp, compelling management information reporting

Create and implement timelines related to project deliverables, assign tasks, drive their completion and manage sponsor/stakeholder expectations of the outcomes

Manage highly complex relationships with multiple stakeholders

Make decisions regarding project resource and funding needs

Supervision Responsibilities:

Develop a culture of success by leading and driving the execution of high-performing, diverse and inclusive talent management (hiring, developing, assessing, etc)

LEAD Reviewer responsibilities and provision of mentoring and regular feedback

• 
Develop and maintain metrics on team performance, providing regular feedback in LEAD and publicizing the teams’ contributions to leadership and other relevant stakeholders

• 
Instil high performing teaming principles

• 
Operate with high degree of independency and autonomy

**Skills And Attributes For Success

**

• In-depth knowledge of the EY business and working in a global partnership

• Strong influencing and consensus-building capability in a complex, matrixed organization where success depends on partnership rather than direct authority

• Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to establish credibility quickly across functions, geographies, and leadership levels

• Experience in large transformation programs within a global environment and/or successfully transforming business functions. This includes demonstrated change leadership skills around disruption and increasing business agility, innovation and adoption

• High level of complex, conceptual problem-solving ability, a wide sphere of influence and a broad-based network are expected

• Financial acumen with demonstrable ability to analyze business reporting and develop business insights

• Demonstrates technology acumen, comfortable with AI and automation

• Proven track record of leading global virtual teams

• Demonstrated drive, determination and resilience, and track record of being able to overcome barriers and achieve results

• Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with a global mindset and ability to communicate and work effectively across culture

**To qualify for the role, you must have:

On behalf of HydraSpecma, Medarbejderne ApS is looking for a Commercial Development Manager who can turn HydraSpecma’s technical capabilities and industrial platform into market access, customer opportunities and a sustainable business within liquid cooling for data centers.

**Build the market - not just the pipeline

**HydraSpecma is building a strategic business area within Data Center Cooling, and the assignment is deliberately broader than a traditional sales role. You will help determine where HydraSpecma should position itself, which customers and partners matter most, and how technical capabilities can be converted into a scalable commercial offering.

You will map the value chain, create access to relevant decision-makers and turn market dialogue into qualified opportunities, business cases, pilot projects and proof-of-concept initiatives. You are expected to understand how projects are initiated, where decisions are made and how long-term positions are built in technically complex environments.

Internally, you will act as a commercial bridge between the market, senior management and HydraSpecma’s technical specialists. Early success is therefore not measured by revenue alone. Your educational background is less important than your ability to connect market insight, technology and commercial opportunity.

**Why HydraSpecma?

HydraSpecma brings strong technical capabilities within hydraulic systems, hoses, pipes and connectors, electrification and renewable energy. Location: Ballerup, Denmark

**Your impact begins here

**As Director of Inspection & Recalls, you will lead a global team of highly experienced specialists responsible for two areas that are fundamental to our quality organisation; how we prepare for and manage health authority inspections, and how we respond when a Quality Defects arises.

You will build on a strong foundation while helping the team rethink how the work gets done, including where data, automation and AI can make us better, faster and more consistent, and where experience, judgement and human interaction must remain at the centre.

**What You'll Bring

**We are looking for an experienced people leader with a strong track record of leading senior specialists, setting clear direction and creating the conditions for expertise to translate into organisational impact. We imagine you will bring:

• Solid leadership experience, including leading and developing experienced specialists.

• 10+ years of experience and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical quality, regulatory or manufacturing environments, with relevant experience in inspection readiness, recall management or interactions with health authorities such as EMA, DKMA or FDA.

• The ability to turn strategy into clear priorities and meaningful action.

• Sound judgement and remain calm and decisive when navigating risk, competing priorities and complex situations.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior leaders, specialists and external partners.

• Curiosity about how technology, data and AI can improve the way teams work, without losing sight of quality, compliance or human accountability.

**What You'll Do

**You will be responsible for setting a clear direction for the team and create an environment where experienced specialists are empowered to take ownership and succeed. Your responsibilities will include:

• Set a clear direction for Inspection & Recalls and turn the wider Quality strategy into priorities the team can act on.

• Lead, coach and develop experienced specialists, creating clear accountability while giving people the space to use their expertise.

• Keep our approach to inspections strong and consistent across Good Practice areas, from preparation and authority interaction through to responses and follow-up.

• Explore where AI, automation and better use of data can genuinely improve preparedness, insight and efficiency, and help the team adopt new approaches responsibly.

• Make sure we learn from inspections, observations, recalls and near misses, turning those lessons into better ways of working.

**Who You'll Work With

**You will lead the global Inspection & Recalls team and report to the Group Vice President for Quality Innovation & Excellence. You will be part of the Quality Innovation & Excellence Leadership team.The role puts you at the intersection of specialist expertise, senior leadership and external authority interaction.

You will also work closely with the area’s Strategic Advisor, who brings deep specialist and industry expertise. The partnership is an important one: you bring the leadership, direction and accountability that enables that expertise, and the expertise of the wider team, to have impact.

There will be room to challenge established approaches, experiment responsibly and build new capabilities. At the same time, this is a role where reliability matters. You will need to balance transformation with the discipline and judgement required in a global quality organisation.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Are you passionate about translating strategic priorities into disciplined execution? Do you have extensive experience leading complex, cross-functional projects in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry? Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

In this role, you will translate GRAPS priorities into integrated plans and disciplined execution across Global Regulatory Affairs, Global Patient Safety, and key enterprise functions. You will lead strategic and operational initiatives involving multiple functions, geographies, vendors, and systems, while establishing clear governance, decision pathways, performance reporting, and risk management.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic perspective with hands-on project leadership in a global and highly regulated environment. You will work closely with the GRAPS Leadership Team, functional leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen quality, compliance, predictability, and organizational scalability.

You will join the GRAPS team (Global Regulatory Affairs & Patient Safety) and report directly to Jethro Ekuta, Chief Regulatory & Safety Officer, who is based in US.

• Lead assigned GRAPS projects and programs from initiation through closeout, establishing clear scope, objectives, governance, integrated plans, milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, budgets, risk controls, and measurable outcomes

You have an enterprise mindset and a strong patient focus, combined with sound judgment regarding business, quality, compliance, and reputational risk.

You are highly structured, analytical, and detail-oriented while maintaining a clear focus on strategic objectives and outcomes. You can simplify complexity, frame options, recommend a path forward, and communicate decisions clearly to executive, technical, and operational audiences.

You are an experienced stakeholder manager who can build alignment, create accountability, and influence without formal authority. You are comfortable working with ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and adapting plans when business needs change.

As a person, you are collaborative, inclusive, culturally aware, and effective in a global matrix organization. You demonstrate high integrity, discretion, ownership, and a strong commitment to transparent communication and follow-through.
